plugins.name: rubber-ducky
plugins.description: Think through a hard or fuzzy problem out loud before writing code — a Socratic partner that reflects, probes, and reframes rather than jumping to solutions.

plugins.name: adversary
plugins.description: Adversarial reviewer and red-teamer. Actively try to break code, PRs, designs, and plans — hunt bugs and failure modes instead of rubber-stamping.

plugins.name: squad
plugins.description: A live panel of your subagents as tiny animated vehicles: what each is doing, its model, effort, steps, context, tokens and time. Real images in Ghostty/kitty, block pixels elsewhere. /squad opens it.

plugins.name: recall
plugins.description: Pull a past Claude Code session from any directory into the current one: a /recall pane to browse and search sessions across all projects, plus a skill, both loading a condensed digest as context.

plugins.name: offload
plugins.description: Delegate a well-specified build task to a cheaper model (Kimi on Ollama Cloud) running in a macOS sandbox, then review the result as an untrusted diff before merging.
